segments.name: Lumber
segments.description: Manufactures and sells softwood lumber for residential construction, repair and remodelling and industrial applications in North America.
segments.evidence: On November 6, 2025, we announced the permanent closure of our lumber mills in Augusta, Georgia and 100 Mile House, British Columbia.

segments.name: North America Engineered Wood Products
segments.description: Produces oriented strand board and other engineered wood panel products for North American residential construction and repair and remodelling markets.
segments.evidence: The most significant uses for our North American lumber, OSB and engineered wood panel products are residential construction, repair and remodelling and industrial applications.

segments.name: Europe Engineered Wood Products
segments.description: Manufactures engineered wood panel products in the U.K. and Europe, with OSB growing as an alternative to plywood.
segments.evidence: Operating earnings for the Europe EWP Segment increased by $74 million compared to 2024 due to the reasons explained above.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay West Fraser for commodity wood products — lumber, engineered wood panels, pulp and paper — at prices sensitive to supply and demand.
revenueModel.evidence: Most of our revenues are from sales of commodity products for which prices are sensitive to variations in supply and demand.

changes.text: In 2025 the company disposed of its pulp mills, exiting the pulp and paper business.
changes.evidence: Selling, general and administration costs decreased by $2 million compared to 2024 due primarily to the impact of the pulp mill disposals and other facility closures and curtailments, and the strengthening of the USD against the CAD.
